comments.content:
Configured thinking budget is always replaced with -1
The changed assignment ignores `self.thinking_budget` and hard-codes `-1` whenever the field is non-None. This also affects the newly introduced default value of `0`, so neither the default nor any explicitly configured budget is passed to the provider.
Impact: Constructing `ChatGoogle` with any non-None `thinking_budget`—for example `0` or a positive limit—causes `ainvoke` to send `{'thinking_budget': -1}` instead of the configured value, making the public configuration ineffective and producing provider behavior different from the requested budget.
Fix: Set `thinking_budget` to `self.thinking_budget`, as before: `{'thinking_budget': self.thinking_budget}`.
